# TBIPTV Xstream

Pay once, no subscription. TBIPTV Xstream is an IPTV player for Xtream Codes or M3U playlists you already have.

In the car it appears in CarPlay on iPhone and Android Auto on Android. Browse Home, channels, films and series, search, and listen in Now Playing.

It does not include, sell or link to channels, films, series or subscriptions.

## What it plays

- Xtream Codes login (server, username, password)
- M3U playlist address

## Price

£2.99 once. No monthly app subscription. No TBIPTV account.

## Picture in Picture

- iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Android phones and tablets: Picture in Picture
- Google TV, Xbox and Windows: mini player in the corner while you browse

## CarPlay and Android Auto

On iPhone it appears in CarPlay. On Android it appears in Android Auto. Browse Home, channels, films and series from the car, search, and listen in Now Playing. CarPlay shows posters, and you search by tapping letters or a letter group. The car plays the sound. It does not include channels.

## Platforms

- iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/tbiptv-xstream/id6837183574
- Mac (Apple silicon and Intel): https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/tbiptv-xstream/id6837183574
- Xbox and Windows: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P69R4HTXG44
- Android phone, tablet and Google TV: coming soon
- Apple TV: coming soon
